title: Accelerating Long-Context Decoding in Large-Scale Hybrid LLMs Without Retraining
abstract: arXiv:2611.06133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The full-attention layers of large language models (LLMs) make every generated token more expensive than the previous one, slowing models down on long-context tasks. Hybrid models reduce this cost by replacing most full-attention layers with linear-attention layers, but the first still dominate decoding at long contexts. We accelerate these remaining layers without any training or weight changes using combined sparse attention: each layer attends to a sliding window of recent tokens, a pinned prefix, and a fixed budget of most relevant tokens in the context. The window size and budget are found on a per-layer basis using a multi-objective search algorithm. Across six hybrid models from three families, from 4B to 397B parameters, the selected configurations preserve their baseline model's accuracy on 21 long-context datasets. Decoding 64k/256k tokens becomes up to 1.26x/2.22x faster on Qwen3.5-4B, 1.20x/2.23x on Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, and 1.1

translated_title: 无需再训练即可加速大规模混合LLM的长上下文解码
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的全注意力层使得每生成一个token的代价都比前一个更高，从而在长上下文任务中拖慢了模型速度。混合模型通过用线性注意力层替换大部分全注意力层来降低这一开销，但全注意力层在长上下文场景下仍然主导解码过程。我们在不进行任何训练或权重修改的情况下，利用组合稀疏注意力来加速这些剩余的层：每一层关注近期token的滑动窗口、固定的前缀（pinned prefix）以及上下文中固定预算的最相关token。窗口大小和预算通过多目标搜索算法逐层确定。在来自三个模型家族的六个混合模型上（参数规模从4B到397B），所选配置在21个长上下文数据集上保持了基线模型的准确率。在解码64k/256k个token时，Qwen3.5-4B上的速度提升最高达1.26倍/2.22倍，Qwen3.5-122B-A10B上提升1.20倍/2.23倍，以及1.1（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需再训练的组合稀疏注意力方法，通过逐层多目标搜索确定滑动窗口、固定前缀与相关token预算，在保持混合架构大模型长上下文准确率的同时，将64k/256k token解码速度最高提升1.26/2.22倍。
en_tdlr: A training-free combined sparse attention approach—sliding window plus pinned prefix plus a relevance budget found via per-layer multi-objective search—accelerates long-context decoding in hybrid LLMs by up to 1.26x/2.22x at 64k/256k tokens while preserving baseline accuracy.
